prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Home maintenance". Read it with fetch before each change. When I tell you about a recurring job, add a row to the table with edit: Task, Every, and Last done and Next due as dates with the year, like "20 Nov 2026". At the start of a month, when I ask, add what's due this month under "This month" as a checklist. When I say I've done one, update its Last done and Next due and tick it. Keep model numbers and warranty dates I mention under "Appliances".

asks: Ask which job I want to keep track of and when I last did it, then add it.
